ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Skydiving performances are a spectator sport generally liked by people. As shown in Figure 8, after an athlete jumps from a helicopter from rest, during the falling process the athlete will be affected by horizontal wind force. Which of the following statements is correct? (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Multi-Physics open-ended question 1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: When the athlete jumps down from a helicopter from rest, and is affected by horizontal wind force during the falling process, what change will occur to the athlete's landing speed as the wind force increases?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: The greater the wind force, the greater the athlete's landing speed, and it may cause harm to the athlete.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image shows a parachuting situation; it can be seen that there is an opened parachute near the airplane, and the athlete is suspended under the parachute and moving downward. The problem stem adds: the athlete jumps down from a helicopter from rest, and is affected by wind force in the horizontal direction during the falling process. Then reason: decompose the motion into the vertical direction and the horizontal direction. The vertical direction is mainly affected by gravity; the horizontal direction is acted on by wind force, which will produce horizontal acceleration. The greater the wind force, the greater the horizontal acceleration, and the greater the horizontal component of velocity obtained when reaching the ground. The athlete's landing speed is the speed synthesized from the vertical component of velocity and the horizontal component of velocity, so when the horizontal component of velocity increases, the resultant speed also increases.

method.method_draft: 从图中确认情境是跳伞运动员在空中下落，降落伞和人会受到侧向风的作用；从题干读取关键信息：运动员从直升飞机上由静止跳下，风力是水平方向，问题问风力增大时着地速度如何变化。解题时把运动分解为竖直方向和水平方向：竖直方向主要受重力影响，水平风力会使运动员获得水平速度；风力越大，水平加速度越大，到达地面时水平分速度越大。着地速度是竖直分速度和水平分速度的合速度，因此水平分速度增大时合速度增大。得出结论：风力越大，运动员着地速度越大，可能造成伤害。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是跳伞情境，可以看到飞机附近有打开的降落伞，运动员悬挂在伞下向下运动。题干补充说明：运动员从直升飞机上由静止跳下，下落过程中受到水平方向风力影响。再推理：把运动分解为竖直方向和水平方向。竖直方向主要受重力影响；水平方向受风力作用，会产生水平加速度。风力越大，水平加速度越大，在到达地面时获得的水平分速度越大。运动员着地速度是竖直分速度和水平分速度合成后的速度，因此水平分速度增大时，合速度也增大。
method.model_answer: 风力越大，运动员着地速度越大，因此可能对运动员造成伤害。
